title: Intrum strengthens financial position in second quarter with successful capital raise
snippet: Intrum AB completed a capital raise strengthening its balance sheet, the company said in a press release. The move resets leverage and supports the turnaround plan.

title: Intrum Justitia AB (0H9P) Receives a Buy from UBS
snippet: UBS analysts reiterated a Buy rating on Intrum Justitia AB, citing improving cash collection performance and a more conservative portfolio strategy.

title: Intrum expected to report SEK 1,169m in adjusted operating profit, consensus
snippet: Market consensus expects Intrum to report SEK 1,169 million in adjusted operating profit for the upcoming quarterly report.
